mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.concept_id, e.canonical_name AS concept_name, m.source, m.table_name, m.expr, m.sql, m.unit, m.summary, m.derived, m.status, m.written_by FROM concept_mappings m JOIN entities e ON e.id = m.concept_id WHERE m.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (#{status}::text IS NULL OR m.status = #{status}) AND (#{q}::text IS NULL OR e.canonical_name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR m.source ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR m.table_name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%') ORDER BY e.canonical_name, m.source, m.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) FROM concept_mappings m JOIN entities e ON e.id = m.concept_id WHERE m.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (#{status}::text IS NULL OR m.status = #{status}) AND (#{q}::text IS NULL OR e.canonical_name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR m.source ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR m.table_name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%')

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'proposed') AS proposed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'confirmed') AS confirmed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'rejected') AS rejected FROM concept_mappings WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}

SELECT r.id, r.before, u.display_name AS changed_by_name, r.changed_at FROM concept_mapping_revisions r JOIN concept_mappings m ON m.id = r.mapping_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.changed_by WHERE r.mapping_id = #{mappingId} AND m.kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY r.changed_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT m.id, m.concept_id, e.canonical_name AS concept_name, m.source, m.table_name, m.expr, m.sql, m.unit, m.summary, m.derived, m.status, m.written_by FROM concept_mappings m JOIN entities e ON e.id = m.concept_id WHERE m.kb_id = #{kbId} AND m.status = 'confirmed' ORDER BY e.canonical_name, m.source LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.id, e.canonical_name AS concept_name, m.summary, m.unit, m.table_name, m.expr FROM concept_mappings m JOIN entities e ON e.id = m.concept_id WHERE m.kb_id = #{kbId} AND m.status = 'confirmed'

SELECT m.id, m.concept_id, e.canonical_name AS concept_name, m.source, m.table_name, m.expr, m.sql, m.unit, m.summary, m.derived, m.status, m.written_by FROM concept_mappings m JOIN entities e ON e.id = m.concept_id WHERE m.kb_id = #{kbId} AND m.id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO concept_mappings (id, kb_id, concept_id, source, table_name, expr, sql, unit, summary, derived, status, decided_by, decided_at, written_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{conceptId}, #{source}, #{tableName}, #{expr}, #{sql}, #{unit}, #{summary}, #{derived}, 'confirmed', #{actor}, now(), #{actor})
mapper.select: SELECT to_jsonb(m) - 'id' - 'kb_id' FROM concept_mappings m WHERE m.id = #{mappingId} AND m.kb_id = #{kbId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO concept_mapping_revisions (id, mapping_id, before, changed_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{mappingId}, #{before,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.JsonNodeTypeHandler}::jsonb, #{actor})
mapper.update: UPDATE concept_mappings SET table_name = #{tableName}, expr = #{expr}, sql = #{sql}, unit = #{unit}, summary = #{summary}, derived = #{derived}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{mappingId} AND kb_id = #{kbId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM entity_types WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND key = #{key}

SELECT m.id, e.canonical_name AS concept_name, m.summary, m.unit, m.table_name, m.expr FROM concept_mappings m JOIN entities e ON e.id = m.concept_id WHERE m.kb_id = #{kbId} AND m.status = 'confirmed' AND (m.embedding IS NULL OR m.embedded_model IS DISTINCT FROM #{model}) ORDER BY m.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.id, e.canonical_name AS concept_name, m.summary, m.unit, m.table_name, m.expr FROM concept_mappings m JOIN entities e ON e.id = m.concept_id WHERE m.id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler})
SELECT id, embedded_text FROM concept_mappings WHERE id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler})
SELECT id FROM concept_mappings WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND concept_id = #{conceptId} AND source = #{source}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO concept_mappings (id, kb_id, concept_id, source, table_name, expr, sql, unit, summary, derived) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{conceptId}, #{source}, #{tableName}, #{expr}, #{sql}, #{unit}, #{summary}, #{derived}) ON CONFLICT (kb_id, concept_id, source) DO UPDATE SET table_name = EXCLUDED.table_name, expr = EXCLUDED.expr, sql = EXCLUDED.sql, unit = EXCLUDED.unit, summary = EXCLUDED.summary, derived = EXCLUDED.derived, updated_at = now() WHERE concept_mappings.status = 'proposed'
mapper.update: UPDATE mapping_exploration_runs SET finished_at = now(), error = left(#{error}, 500) WHERE id = #{id}
